sources.title: GLM-4.5 original release announcement
sources.evidence: Complete indexed original announcement is dated July 28, 2025 and explicitly says GLM-4.5 and Air are available in chat, API and open weights. Gives exact GLM-4.5 nominal 355B/32B, hybrid reasoning and native function calling. Direct HTML retrieval returned a client shell; indexed article supplied the full substantive page.

sources.title: GLM-4.5 technical report, architecture section and Table 1
sources.publisher: GLM-4.5 Team, Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University
sources.evidence: First-party August 8 report explicitly gives GLM-4.5 355B total and 32B activated. Table 1 caption includes MTP parameters but excludes word embeddings and output layer. Exact column: 3 dense layers, 89 MoE layers, 1 MTP layer, 160 routed experts with 8 selected plus 1 shared expert. Uses GQA, partial RoPE and QK-Norm.

sources.title: GLM-4.5 official checkpoint card at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Exact hybrid reasoning BF16 checkpoint; explicitly releases base, hybrid reasoning and FP8 variants under MIT for commercial use and further development. Gives 355B/32B nominal size, thinking/non-thinking modes and tool use. Separate Air, Base and FP8 links avoid variant confusion.

sources.title: GLM-4.5 checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Glm4MoeForCausalLM with 92 decoder layers, first 3 dense, 160 routed experts/top 8 and 1 shared expert; num_nextn_predict_layers=1, untied embeddings, BF16 and max_position_embeddings=131072. No vision/audio encoder is configured. Config corroborates topology, not an exact full parameter inventory.

sources.title: GLM-4.5 checkpoint chat template
sources.evidence: Template serializes text, thinking control and reasoning content, structured XML tool calls, function definitions and tool responses. It does not establish native image/audio/video input.

sources.title: Native GLM-4.5 API model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact GLM-4.5 overview explicitly says text input and output, 128K context, 96K maximum output, 355B/32B MoE, switchable thinking.type and function calls. Context and maximum output are distinct. This is documented capability, not a test of endpoint operation.

sources.title: Official GLM-4.5 checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public ungated repository containing safetensors weight shards, index and tokenizer/config files; inspected revision cbb2c7cfb52fa128a9660cb1a7a78e017899e115. July 20 repository creation is not substituted for the explicit July 28 public launch. No full weight shards were downloaded.

sources.title: Official GLM repository with later model comparison/download table
sources.evidence: Current repository includes GLM-4.6 and 4.7 entries, while its separately labeled GLM-4.5 row retains 355B-A32B and MIT release statement. Later siblings are not used to change original GLM-4.5 context or capabilities.

sources.title: Z.ai original corporate release distributed by PR Newswire
sources.evidence: Original press release supplied by Z.ai, July 28, 2025, names GLM-4.5-Air and its 106B figure. Corroborates developer launch date independently of catalog or repository creation.

name.note: Exact hybrid reasoning release, distinct from GLM-4.5-Air, Base, FP8, X and Flash variants.

developer.note: Product developer is Z.ai, formerly Zhipu AI. The original technical report credits the GLM-4.5 team with Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University affiliations.

family.note: Normalized identifier for the explicitly named GLM model family.

release_date.note: Original announcement explicitly states public chat, API and open-weight availability on July 28. Earlier repository creation and later paper/provider pages are not treated as first release.

open_weights.note: Exact hybrid reasoning model has public ungated weights; this is not merely publication of serving code.

license.note: Official model card explicitly applies MIT to these model releases. No separate LICENSE file exists at the attempted checkpoint path; the explicit model-card grant is the evidence.

parameters_b.note: Author-reported nominal count. Table 1 includes MTP but excludes word embeddings and output layer. Proposed nonembedding_with_mtp scope makes that boundary explicit; this is not an exact complete-checkpoint count or a sum reconstructed from config.

active_parameters_b.note: Author-reported nominal activated count under the same nonembedding-with-MTP convention. Proposed scope records that convention, not a measured whole inference phase or all executed modules for every token.

architecture.note: Decoder Transformer MoE: 3 dense plus 89 MoE layers, 160 routed experts with 8 selected and 1 shared expert, GQA with partial RoPE and QK-Norm; one additional MoE MTP layer is documented.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint maximum position count is 131072, matching the advertised 128K context. Native API maximum output 96K is a separate limit.

modalities.note: Native API explicitly specifies text input/output, consistent with text-only checkpoint configuration and template. Agent-generated artifacts are not native media modalities.

reasoning.note: Hybrid thinking/non-thinking modes are explicit in the release, checkpoint template and native thinking.type parameter.

tool_call.note: Original native function-calling claim is corroborated by structured tool definitions, tool_call serialization and response handling in the checkpoint template.

description.value: Text MoE model with switchable reasoning, tool calling and a 128K-token context window.
description.note: Replaces subjective usefulness wording with supported architecture and capabilities.

patch.notes: GLM-4.5 launched July 28, 2025. Z.ai reports nominal 355B total and 32B activated parameters; its technical report explicitly includes the MTP layer but excludes word embeddings and the output layer. These scoped figures are not exact complete-checkpoint totals or measured inference-phase counts. The exact BF16 checkpoint supports 131072 positions; the native API advertises 128K context and a separate 96K maximum output. The model accepts and produces text, with switchable thinking and structured tool calls.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Adds MIT, MoE and nominal 355B/32B with the original report counting convention: MTP included, embeddings/output layer excluded. Confirms July 28 release, exact 131072 context, text-only scope, switchable reasoning and tool calls. No full weight downloads or exact complete parameter tally claimed.
